# Fathers Front Systeme.io Site Shell

This is the single installation base for the Fathers Front header, mobile menu, and footer on Systeme.io pages.

Install it in the order below. The shared styles are installed once. Do not also install the older standalone header or footer CSS, because this file replaces both.

## 1. Install the shared styles once

In Systeme.io, open the page settings and find the Tracking or Custom code area. Paste this entire block into the Header code field.

```html
<style>
  html,
  body {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: "FF Libre Franklin";
    src: url("https://fathersfront.com/fonts/site/libre-franklin-400-600.woff2") format("woff2");
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400 600;
    font-display: swap;
  }

@font-face {
    font-family: "FF Barlow Condensed";
    src: url("https://fathersfront.com/fonts/site/barlow-condensed-600.woff2") format("woff2");
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-display: swap;
  }

  @font-face {
    font-family: "FF Tungsten Condensed";
    src: url("data:font/truetype;base64,") format("truetype");
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-display: swap;
  }

  .ff-sio-header,
  .ff-sio-header * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .ff-sio-header {
    --ff-ink: #171412;
    --ff-cream: #f4ecdc;
    --ff-oxblood: #912d2f;
    --ff-ember: #e84509;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 9999;
    width: 100%;
    height: 126px;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: rgba(13, 11, 10, 0.96);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.18);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .ff-sio-header a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__inner {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 48px));
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 34px;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__brand {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.16em;
    color: #e9dec8;
    font: 700 60px/0.9 "FF Tungsten Condensed", "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.035em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__brand-front {
    color: var(--ff-oxblood);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav {
    min-width: 0;
    margin-left: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 34px;
    font: 600 28px/1 "FF Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > a,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label {
    position: relative;
    padding: 49px 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > a::after,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::before {
    position: absolute;
    right: 100%;
    bottom: 34px;
    left: 0;
    height: 2px;
    content: "";
    background: var(--ff-ember);
    transition: right 180ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > a:hover::after,
  .ff-sio-header__nav > a:focus-visible::after,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown:hover .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::before,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown:focus-within .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::before {
    right: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__dropdown {
    position: relative;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::after {
    margin-left: 0.35em;
    color: var(--ff-oxblood);
    content: "+";
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu {
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 0;
    width: 250px;
    padding: 8px 0;
    display: grid;
    background: #11100f;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transform: translateY(8px);
    transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, visibility 180ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu a {
    position: relative;
    padding: 14px 20px 12px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu a::after {
    position: absolute;
    right: 100%;
    bottom: 8px;
    left: 20px;
    height: 2px;
    content: "";
    background: var(--ff-ember);
    transition: right 180ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu a:hover::after,
  .ff-sio-header__submenu a:focus-visible::after {
    right: 20px;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__dropdown:hover .ff-sio-header__submenu,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown:focus-within .ff-sio-header__submenu {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta {
    padding: 15px 18px;
    border: 2px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
    transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta:hover,
  .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta:focus-visible {
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: rgba(145, 45, 47, 0.16);
    border-color: var(--ff-ember);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle {
    display: none;
    border-radius: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__mobile-heading {
    display: none;
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .ff-sio-header {
      height: 76px;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__inner {
      width: min(100% - 30px, 1180px);
    }

    .ff-sio-header__brand {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10001;
      font-size: 42px;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__toggle {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10001;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin: 0 0 0 auto;
      padding: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      color: var(--ff-cream);
      background: #0d0b0a;
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.28);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__toggle span {
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      display: block;
      background: currentColor;
      transition: transform 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
    }

    .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
    }

    .ff-sio-header__nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 10000;
      min-height: 100svh;
      max-height: 100svh;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 96px 24px 32px;
      display: none;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0;
      color: var(--ff-cream);
      background: var(--ff-ink);
      font-size: 28px;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__nav.is-open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__mobile-heading {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      padding: 0 0 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      color: #e9dec8;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.28);
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__mobile-heading b {
      color: #a99f92;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__nav > a,
    .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 58px;
      padding: 14px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.14);
    }

    .ff-sio-header__nav > a::after,
    .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::before,
    .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__dropdown {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.14);
    }

    .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label {
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__submenu {
      position: static;
      width: auto;
      padding: 0 0 14px 18px;
      display: grid;
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
      transform: none;
      background: transparent;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__submenu a {
      padding: 8px 0 8px 15px;
      color: #a99f92;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
      font-size: 16px;
      white-space: normal;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__submenu a::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 58px;
      margin-top: 24px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 420px) {
    .ff-sio-header__brand {
      font-size: 36px;
    }
  }

.ff-sio-footer,
  .ff-sio-footer * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer {
    --ff-ink: #171412;
    --ff-cream: #f4ecdc;
    --ff-oxblood: #912d2f;
    --ff-ember: #e84509;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 80px 0 35px;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: #0c0a09;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.16);
    font-family: "FF Libre Franklin", Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__shell {
    width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 48px));
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(130px, 0.7fr) minmax(180px, 0.8fr);
    gap: 60px;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__dispatch {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__kicker {
    margin: 0 0 12px;
    color: #8d8378;
    font: 600 11px "FF Barlow Condensed", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__title {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    font: 700 42px/0.95 "FF Barlow Condensed", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__description {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 12px 0 22px;
    color: #a99f92;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
    max-width: 580px;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form input {
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    height: 50px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 16px;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: #100e0d;
    border: 1px solid #675d53;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    font: 500 14px "FF Libre Franklin", Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form input::placeholder {
    color: #8d8378;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form input:focus {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ff-cream);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form button {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-height: 50px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 18px;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: transparent;
    border: 2px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font: 600 12px "FF Barlow Condensed", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form button:hover,
  .ff-sio-footer__form button:focus-visible {
    color: #000;
    background: #fff;
    border-color: #fff;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__links {
    display: grid;
    align-content: start;
    gap: 15px;
    font: 600 15px "FF Barlow Condensed", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__links a {
    width: fit-content;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    transition: color 160ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__links a:hover,
  .ff-sio-footer__links a:focus-visible {
    color: var(--ff-ember);
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__note {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    color: #8d8378;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__pillars {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    font: 600 20px/1.15 "FF Barlow Condensed", Arial, sans-serif;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__pillars i {
    color: var(--ff-oxblood);
    font-style: normal;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__social {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin: 28px 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__social a {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    border: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.25);
    transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__social a:hover,
  .ff-sio-footer__social a:focus-visible {
    color: #fff;
    background: var(--ff-oxblood);
    border-color: var(--ff-oxblood);
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__social svg {
    width: 19px;
    height: 19px;
    display: block;
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__social .ff-sio-footer__social-fill {
    fill: currentColor;
    stroke: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__legal {
    margin: 0;
    color: #8d8378;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__sr-only {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .ff-sio-footer {
      padding: 64px 0 30px;
    }

    .ff-sio-footer__shell {
      width: min(100% - 36px, 1180px);
    }

    .ff-sio-footer__grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
    }

    .ff-sio-footer__title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 10vw, 46px);
    }

    .ff-sio-footer__note {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 560px) {
    .ff-sio-footer__form {
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .ff-sio-footer__form button {
      width: 100%;
    }
  }
</style>
```

## 2. Add the header to the top of the page

Add a Raw HTML element as the first element on the page. Paste this block into it.

```html
<header class="ff-sio-header">
  <div class="ff-sio-header__inner">
    <a class="ff-sio-header__brand" href="https://fathersfront.com/" aria-label="Fathers Front home">
      <span>Fathers</span>
      <span class="ff-sio-header__brand-front">Front</span>
    </a>

    <button
      class="ff-sio-header__toggle"
      type="button"
      aria-expanded="false"
      aria-controls="ff-sio-primary-menu"
      aria-label="Open navigation"
    >
      <span></span>
      <span></span>
      <span></span>
    </button>

    <nav class="ff-sio-header__nav" id="ff-sio-primary-menu" aria-label="Primary navigation">
      <div class="ff-sio-header__mobile-heading">
        <span>Fathers Front</span>
        <b>Menu</b>
      </div>

      <a href="https://fathersfront.com/">Home</a>
      <a href="https://fathersfront.com/books/">Books</a>
      <a href="https://fathersfront.com/articles/">Articles</a>
      <a href="https://fathersfront.com/speaking/">Speaking</a>

      <div class="ff-sio-header__dropdown">
        <a class="ff-sio-header__dropdown-label" href="https://fathersfront.com/about/">About</a>
        <div class="ff-sio-header__submenu">
          <a href="https://fathersfront.com/about/">About Steve</a>
          <a href="https://fathersfront.com/the-framework/">The Framework</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <a class="ff-sio-header__cta" href="https://fathersfront.com/work-with-steve/">Work With Steve</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>
```

## 3. Add the footer to the bottom of the page

Add a Raw HTML element as the final element on the page. Paste this block into it.

Before publishing, replace YOUR_SYSTEME_IO_FORM_ACTION_URL with the action from the correct Systeme.io opt-in form. If Systeme.io does not expose a form action, remove the form markup and place a native Systeme.io form inside the footer area using the class f-sio-footer__form.

```html

</footer>
```

## 4. Install the shared JavaScript once

Paste this block into the page Footer code field. It controls the mobile menu, updates the copyright year, and preserves campaign parameters across Fathers Front links.

```html
<script>
  (function () {
    var header = document.querySelector(".ff-sio-header");
    var footer = document.querySelector(".ff-sio-footer");

    if (header) {
      var toggle = header.querySelector(".ff-sio-header__toggle");
      var menu = header.querySelector(".ff-sio-header__nav");
      var headerLinks = header.querySelectorAll("a");

      function setMenu(open) {
        menu.classList.toggle("is-open", open);
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", open ? "Close navigation" : "Open navigation");
        document.documentElement.style.overflow = open ? "hidden" : "";
      }

      toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setMenu(toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true");
      });

      headerLinks.forEach(function (link) {
        link.addEventListener("click", function () {
          setMenu(false);
        });
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape") setMenu(false);
      });

      window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
        if (window.innerWidth > 980) setMenu(false);
      });
    }

    if (footer) {
      var year = footer.querySelector("[data-ff-current-year]");
      if (year) year.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
    }

    var allowed = ["utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term"];
    var incoming = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var siteLinks = document.querySelectorAll(
      '.ff-sio-header a[href^="https://fathersfront.com/"], .ff-sio-footer a[href^="https://fathersfront.com/"]'
    );

    siteLinks.forEach(function (link) {
      var url = new URL(link.href);

      allowed.forEach(function (key) {
        if (incoming.has(key) && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
          url.searchParams.set(key, incoming.get(key));
        }
      });

      link.href = url.toString();
    });
  })();
</script>
```

## Final checklist

- Remove any previously installed standalone Fathers Front header or footer CSS and JavaScript.
- Keep only one header Raw HTML block and one footer Raw HTML block.
- Connect the Dispatch form before publishing.
- Test the desktop About dropdown.
- Test the mobile menu open, close, Escape key, and page scrolling.
- Test at least one link back to fathersfront.com.
